findings.title: Background reader thread is not joined before asserting or exiting the test
findings.body: In `createMultiDeleteMultiReadMulti`, the background `Thread` that continuously reads groups is started on line 139, and the main thread immediately asserts `assertThat(caughtExceptions, Matchers.empty())` after setting `deletedAll.set(true)` without calling `thread.join()`. If an in-flight `groups()` call is still executing when the last group is deleted and throws an exception slightly after `deletedAll` is set, the assertion can pass before `caughtExceptions.add(e)` runs, masking a failure. In addition, the still-running request can leak into subsequent tests in `GroupTest`. Store the `Thread` reference and `join()` it before asserting on `caughtExceptions`.

findings.title: Paginated getSubGroupsStream overloads still dereference null modelSupplier.get() when group is concurrently deleted
findings.body: `getSubGroupsCount()` was updated to guard against `modelSupplier.get()` returning `null` when the cached group has been concurrently removed from the database, but the three overloaded `getSubGroupsStream(...)` methods right above it (lines 256, 262, and 268) still call `modelSupplier.get().getSubGroupsStream(...)` directly. If any of those methods are invoked on a `GroupAdapter` whose underlying group was concurrently deleted, `modelSupplier.get()` returns `null` and a `NullPointerException` is thrown. They should handle a `null` model (for example by returning `Stream.empty()`).
